subject: session: rename and unify location of interfaces, and some refactor (#62498)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. Changes are a mechanical interface/package refactor within scope: introduce `planctx.Common` and embed it into `sessionctx.Context`, move the `Session` interface from `pkg/session/types` to `pkg/session/sessionapi`, and rename session-state encode/decode entrypoints to `EncodeStates`/`DecodeStates` with corresponding executor call-site updates. No plausible Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, privilege/visibility, transaction/session behavior, or runtime handling for the touched `executor`/`planner`/`session`/`sessionctx`/`store`/`table` areas.
